title: Tendant Gate Script Capability Manifest v1
description: Statically-enforced capability manifest a WASM gate script ships with. The host inspects the WASM import section before instantiation; any import outside this manifest's `reads` allowlist rejects the upload without running the module.

manifest_version.description: The manifest grammar version. v1 is the only supported value in Phase 5. Bumping this is a versioned breaking change per the Phase-2 contract-versioning policy.

tool.description: The tool's globalUri (e.g. 'tendant://tools/send-email'). MUST match the toolId argument of attachGateScript / compileAndAttachGateScript or the upload is rejected with INVALID_MANIFEST(reason: 'tool_mismatch').

entrypoint.description: The single exported function name the host will call. v1 only supports 'evaluate'.

reads.description: The static allowlist of host data domains this script reads. Each entry maps 1:1 to a host-function module: 'call.args' → call.get(); 'contacts' → contacts.isKnown(addr); 'calendar' → calendar.query(window); 'task.context' → task.context(key); 'owner.rule' → owner.rule(key). The host walks the WASM import section before instantiation and rejects any import whose corresponding `reads` entry is missing. `log(msg)` is always available and does NOT require a `reads` entry — it is a bounded sink, not a read.

egress.description: Reserved for the future `external_fetch` capability. v1 only accepts the empty array — a script that names ANY egress endpoint is rejected at upload with INVALID_MANIFEST(reason: 'unknown_capability'). Re-introducing egress later will require a manifest_version bump.

limits.description: Per-script resource limits. The host enforces min(manifest-declared, deployment-ceiling) at runtime; a manifest declaring limits above the deployment ceiling is rejected at upload (INVALID_MANIFEST: timeout_exceeds_ceiling | memory_exceeds_ceiling).

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout for evaluate(). On expiry the host closes the wazero module via context cancellation. Default 250; deployment ceiling default 1000 (TENDANT_GATESCRIPT_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS).

memory_pages.description: Linear-memory cap in WASM pages (64 KiB each). Default 64 pages = 4 MiB; deployment ceiling default 256 pages = 16 MiB (TENDANT_GATESCRIPT_MAX_MEMORY_PAGES).
